answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 20682 Country: Pakistan Title: If you get to find out that your wife is not a virgin after marriage and that she has lied about it, what is the best way forward for the husband? Question: Assalam o Alaikum, If you get to find out that your wife is not a virgin after marriage and that she has lied about it, what is the best way forward for the husband? Thanks Answer ID: 20682 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 487/339/L=1431) If the wife does tauba from doing wrong activity in future then it is better to keeo her as wife. It is not necessary to divorce her. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
